시편 7:1.content: Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the Lord, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite. O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

시편 7:2.content: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

시편 7:3.content: O Lord my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

시편 7:4.content: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)

시편 7:5.content: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.

시편 7:6.content: Arise, O Lord, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.

시편 7:7.content: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.

시편 7:8.content: The Lord shall judge the people: judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.

시편 7:9.content: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.

시편 7:10.content: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.

시편 7:11.content: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.

시편 7:12.content: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

시편 7:13.content: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

시편 7:14.content: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

시편 7:15.content: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.

시편 7:16.content: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

시편 7:17.content: I will praise the Lord according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the Lord most high.
